Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 31 января ст. ст., «Трифена Кизическая, мц.», with the rank word and the office left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's own heading for 31. јануар ст. ст. (civil 2026-02-13), „Света мученица Трифена“. The words „Света мученица“ are left off: the site composes the rank itself. The heading gives no epithet, so the form is bare — the Prologue names no city for her at all.
